title: DG Tools · Debrief
description: The after-action record for a session. Reads the world's chat log, classifies what it finds — every roll against its target and result, sanity lost, damage taken, scene moves, and whatever the other dg-* tools announced — and hands the whole run over as one digest for the Handler's Debrief page to ask questions from. Reads only; writes nothing to any document. Personal use, not for redistribution.
